HexKagune 1.0.26 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 42). Testing build.

- **Peace has its own run (Naoya-style):** tipped far forward, head up, arms swept straight back, long fast strides with high knees.
- **War has its own run (the warpath):** hunched low, head thrust out and glaring up, wide claw arms pumping, every footfall a stomp the body drops into.
- **The legs follow your real speed:** the faster you go, the faster they turn over, so there's no moonwalking at final-kakuja speed.
- **Attacks no longer touch your legs on the ground:** blows take the upper body only and your legs keep running under them. In the air, and during War's dash and Peace's ascent, dive and landing, blows keep their legs.
- **Sprinting is much faster:** War +60%, Peace +75% on top of their form speed.
- **Sprint afterimages:** ghosts trail you, the newest one the whole form. Peace's are pale ice, War's crimson.
- **Footfalls when sprinting:** War's stamp soot out of the ground (every other one cracks it), Peace's leave a glint.
- **Blade trails stay on the blades** through leans and turns. Peace barely leans while striking, so its blades are drawn where they really cut.
- **First person:** your hands wear the form's arm armour, Peace's blades show at rest too (not only during moves), and War's rinkaku show whenever they reach out ahead of you.
